item.title: Peoria fire: Vacant home blaze causes $225K in damage
item.description: A fire at a vacant Central Peoria home caused an estimated $225,000 in damage, with the cause determined to be accidental and no injuries reported.

item.title: Peoria Housing Authority CEO resigns amid CFO termination
item.description: The Peoria Housing Authority's CFO was terminated due to financial irregularities, and the CEO resigned in an unrelated matter, with the board appointing an interim CEO to provide operational stability during the transition.

item.title: Canton house fire burns itself out; one cat dies
item.description: The Canton Fire Department responded to a house fire that burned itself out due to poor ventilation, causing heavy fire damage to the kitchen and smoke damage to the rest of the house, and resulting in the death of the homeowner's cat.

item.title: Limestone Community High shatters Easterseals fundraising record
item.description: Limestone Community High School broke their record for their yearly Easterseals fundraiser by raising $137,605, which is over $12,000 more than last year's total, to help kids with developmental delays, disabilities, or other special needs.

item.title: Peoria woman indicted for aggravated DUI after University Street crash
item.description: Ganala T. Johnson, 28, was indicted on five counts of aggravated DUI after being involved in a crash on February 6, and was released with several conditions attached to her release, including not drinking alcohol.

item.title: Peoria County jury finds man guilty in teen sexual assault case
item.description: Jordan W. Gibson, 21, was found guilty of sexually assaulting a 14-year-old girl and faces up to 15 years in prison, with sentencing set for April 24.

item.title: Unit 5 teacher placed on paid leave during police investigation
item.description: A Chiddix Junior High teacher and coach was put on administrative paid leave following a search warrant executed by the Bloomington Police Department, with no arrests or charges made yet.

item.title: Illinois VA marks anniversary of Desert Storm's ceasefire
item.description: The Illinois Department of Veterans Affairs will commemorate the 35th anniversary of the ceasefire that ended Operation Desert Storm with a ceremony at the Illinois State Military Museum on Saturday.

item.title: Bloomington reveals historic budget for public infrastructure improvements
item.description: The City of Bloomington has proposed a budget of just under 371 million dollars for the 2027 fiscal year, which is a 310 million dollar increase from the previous year, to fund much needed infrastructure projects such as water capital projects, housing revitalization, and road improvements.

item.title: 'Can Pekin win a legal battle with a data center?' asked locals
item.description: The city of Pekin held a town hall to discuss the potential construction of a data center, with some residents concerned about a potential legal battle with the multi-billion dollar company and the impact on the area's economy and environment.
